executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors across multiple files. The root cause is missing Lombok-generated methods (builders, getters, setters) in entity and DTO classes, indicating Lombok annotations are not being processed correctly during compilation. Additionally, there is a duplicate constructor definition and a missing interface method implementation.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition in ColumnNotFoundException class. The class likely has both an explicit constructor and a Lombok-generated constructor.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the duplicate constructor definition. If using Lombok @AllArgsConstructor or @RequiredArgsConstructor, remove the manually defined constructor.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() in ErrorResponse (6 occurrences in GlobalExceptionHandler)
errors.root_cause: Lombok @Builder annotation is not generating the builder() method for ErrorResponse DTO. This affects GlobalExceptionHandler at lines 26, 38, 50, 62, 79, and 92.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure @Builder annotation is present on ErrorResponse class. Verify Lombok is properly configured in pom.xml with annotation processing enabled. Add lombok-maven-plugin if missing.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: multiple getter/setter methods (getId, setId, getTitle, getStatus, getUserId, getCreatedAt, etc.)

errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation to Task entity class or ensure @Getter and @Setter are present. Verify Lombok dependency is in pom.xml and annotation processing is enabled in maven-compiler-plugin configuration.

errors.fix_recommendation: Add the missing countByColumnId(String columnId) method implementation to InMemoryTaskDataStore class. Return the count of tasks matching the given columnId.
